We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from previous step to the molecule. The previous step gave mapped_rxn and template_id 29646. We need to apply that template to the target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id.

We have initial_molecule SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to apply template 29646. Use apply_template.
